title: feat(plugin-auth): the organization's pending-invitation limit is a host setting, OS_ORG_INVITATION_LIMIT, that can be turned off
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSLDKWQ8v7cxY9uDGijfncD)_

Fixes #33196

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：一个组织同时挂着的「未接受邀请」上限，现在由宿主用环境变量 `OS_ORG_INVITATION_LIMIT` 决定：填数字就是上限，填 `off`（或 `unlimited` / `none`）就不限。
- 为什么改：第三方账号组件默认一个组织最多 100 封待接受邀请，第 101 封直接 403。托管要支持环境批量导入成员，需要把它关掉，控制台和环境两边规则一致。
- 风险与回滚：不设置时行为与 main 完全一样（仍是 100，有对照测试钉住）；填 0 或写错也按「未设置」处理，不会变成拒绝所有邀请。回滚 = revert 本 PR，不涉及数据。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-limit.ts`（取值规则）和 `auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts` 里新增的一行 `invitationLimit`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/invitation-limit.test.ts`，预期 8/8 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地；合并后托管侧设置 `OS_ORG_INVITATION_LIMIT=off`。

## What changes

- **The refusal.** better-auth's `/organization/invite-member` (1.7.12, `crud-invites.mjs` L167-172) counts the organization's pending invitations and answers `403 INVITATION_LIMIT_REACHED` ("Invitation limit reached") once the count reaches `invitationLimit`. The framework passed none, so the vendor's `?? 100` applied. The count is per organization, not per inviter.
- **The setting.** `OS_ORG_INVITATION_LIMIT`, an env-driven host option, beside its two neighbours in the same options object: `organizationLimit` (`OS_ORG_LIMIT`) and `membershipLimit` (`OS_ORG_MEMBERSHIP_LIMIT`).
  - unset, blank, `0`, negative or unparsable → nothing is passed; the vendor's 100 stays. A deployment that sets nothing is unchanged, and a typo never becomes a limit that refuses every invitation.
  - a positive integer `N` → `invitationLimit: N`.
  - `off`, `unlimited` or `none` (any case, trimmed) → `invitationLimit: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`.
- **Why this shape.** better-auth's option is typed `number | (fn → number)`. It has no "off" spelling: `false` or `null` would fall back to 100, and `0` would refuse everything. So "no limit" is passed as `MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`, the same choice `membershipLimit` already makes (finite, because the value travels through option plumbing). An env var rather than an `AuthManagerOptions` field, because both sibling limits are env-driven host options and the cloud sets them the same way; the seat accepted this shape and the `packages/types` surface before code.
- **Files.** `packages/types/src/env.ts`: `resolveOrgInvitationLimit()` (answers `number | 'off' | undefined`) and `ORG_INVITATION_LIMIT_OFF_VALUES`, beside `resolveOrgMembershipLimit()`. `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-limit.ts`: `resolveInvitationLimitOption()` maps that to the option. `auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts`: one spread, so unset adds no key at all. Docs: a row in the Authentication table of `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`. Not an authorable `auth-config.zod.ts` key.
- **Other doors.** No other framework door applies its own pending-invitation limit. A cloud-managed environment refuses every invitation outright (#25083, `beforeCreateInvitation` → `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`), and admin user import sends account invitations, not organization invitations.

## Tests

- **New `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-limit.test.ts`.** A real `AuthManager` over the installed better-auth and the in-memory engine (the `invitation-resend-expired.test.ts` harness, cut to one owner). The deciding invitation always goes through the vendor's own `POST /organization/invite-member`; the pending rows before it are the first real invitation's row, cloned, so the count is the one the vendor reads.
  - ⭐ off: with 100 pending, the 101st is accepted (200, `status: 'pending'`, 101 pending).
  - ⭐ N = 3: the 3rd is accepted and the 4th refused with `INVITATION_LIMIT_REACHED`.
  - ⭐ CONTROL, unset: with 100 pending the 101st is refused `403 {"message":"Invitation limit reached","code":"INVITATION_LIMIT_REACHED"}` and nothing is written; with 99 pending the 100th is accepted, so the refusal is the limit and not the harness.
  - Unit: unset passes nothing; `3` passes 3; `off` passes a finite number above a million; `0`, `abc`, `-1` pass nothing.
- **`packages/types/src/env.test.ts`**: a `resolveOrgInvitationLimit` block (unset, N, the off spellings in any case, unusable values including `0`, `false`, `infinity`, and independence from `OS_ORG_MEMBERSHIP_LIMIT`).

## Acceptance notes

- **Ruling.** The card quotes the maintainer's word via cloud#4465: 「邀请上线也接受你的建议」, i.e. no pending-invitation limit, through an explicit framework setting. This PR adds the setting; turning it off is the cloud card's step. Nothing more was inferred from cloud#4465, which this session cannot read.
- **Ruling grep** (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) on the touched surface: `auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts` L162 (Ruling 6355206139, the `external` role) and L614-617 (invitation e-mail locale rulings). Neither governs the limit. No hits in the other touched files' edited regions.
- **Restart needed.** The value is read when the auth plugin builds its organization plugin, so a change needs a process reload, like its two neighbours.
- **Serial.** No open PR touches the files here (checked before push). #33177 had already merged and does not touch them. #33181 and #33183 work on other `plugin-auth` files.

## Verification

All readings at head `37a7086e` (commit `d545f1fb`, then `origin/main` merged once; the merge brought only `ui/` and `docs/design` changes, none on the touched files, so no gate was re-run after it). Base `66919b66`.

<details><summary>Measured at main's wiring first (live 101st refusal)</summary>

With `auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts` restored to `main` and the new test file run against it, through the vendor's own `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member` on a real `AuthManager`:

- 100 pending in the organization, the 101st invitation: `403 {"message":"Invitation limit reached","code":"INVITATION_LIMIT_REACHED"}`, still 100 pending (the CONTROL pins pass on main).
- `OS_ORG_INVITATION_LIMIT=off` → the same 403 (`expected 403 to be 200`); `=3` → the 4th is accepted (`expected 200 to be 403`). 2 failed | 6 passed: main has no setting.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each leg mutated, red recorded, restored; byte-compared after)</summary>

- **A1, unset passes "no limit"** (`return limit ?? INVITATION_LIMIT_UNBOUNDED`): 3 failed | 5 passed. CONTROL: `expected 200 to be 403` (the 101st was written), unit: `expected 9007199254740991 to be undefined`, `value="0": expected 9007199254740991 to be undefined`.
- **A2, `off` ignored** (`if (limit === 'off') return undefined`): 2 failed | 6 passed. `off: the 101st pending invitation is accepted`: `{"message":"Invitation limit reached","code":"INVITATION_LIMIT_REACHED"}: expected 403 to be 200`.
- **A3, N ignored** (`return undefined`): 2 failed | 6 passed. `a number N`: the 4th answered 200 (`expected 200 to be 403`); unit `expected undefined to be 3`.
- **A4, `0` read as a limit** (`n >= 0` in `resolveOrgInvitationLimit`): 1 failed | 4 passed in the types block: `value="0": expected +0 to be undefined`.

</details>
